table.retrieve:
SELECT
	GuestCheckInCode=GC.GuestCheckInCode,
	CheckInDate=GC.CheckInDate,
	CheckInRoom=(SELECT LTRIM(RTRIM(GR.NAME)) + ', ' + LTRIM(RTRIM(F.Name))
			FROM GuestRoom GR, GuestRoomFloor F
			WHERE GR.GuestRoomCode=GC.CheckInRoom AND
				GR.GuestRoomFloorCode=F.GuestRoomFloorCode),
	CheckInBy = (SELECT U.UserName FROM Users U WHERE U.UserCode=GC.CheckInBy),
	CurrentRoom=(SELECT LTRIM(RTRIM(GR.NAME)) + ', ' + LTRIM(RTRIM(F.Name))
			FROM GuestRoom GR, GuestRoomFloor F
			WHERE GR.GuestRoomCode=GC.CurrentRoom AND
				GR.GuestRoomFloorCode=F.GuestRoomFloorCode),
	CheckOut=GC.CheckOut,
	RegNo = G.RegNo,
	Name= G.Name,
	G.GuestCode,   
	G.CustCode,   
	G.Gender,   
	G.NIC,   
	G.FHName,   
	G.Address,   
	G.Mobile,   
	G.Phone,   
	G.Fax,   
	G.Email,   
	G.Profession,   
	G.Nationality,   
	G.Passport,   
	G.Reference,
	ComingFrom=GC.ComingFrom,
	ArrivalDate=GC.ArrivalDate,
	DepartureDate=GC.DepartureDate,
	StayPeriod = GC.StayPeriod,
	GCS.ServiceCode,
	GCS.Qty,
	GCS.SalePrice,
	GCS.ServiceFlatDisc,
	GCS.DiscPerc,
	TotalAmount = Round(GCS.Qty * (GCS.SalePrice - GCS.ServiceFlatDisc) * (1 - GCS.DiscPerc * 0.01),2),
	ExpectedTotalAmt = Round(GC.StayPeriod * GCS.Qty * (GCS.SalePrice - GCS.ServiceFlatDisc) * (1 - GCS.DiscPerc * 0.01),2),
	CashTendered = GC.CashTendered,
	CashCharged = ISNULL(GC.CashCharged, 0) + ISNULL((SELECT SUM(MC.Amount) FROM MasterCashWin MC WHERE MC.DocumentCode = GC.GuestCheckInCode AND MC.DocumentType = 'GC'), 0),
	CashBack = GC.CashBack
FROM
	GuestCheckIn GC 
	LEFT OUTER JOIN GuestCheckInService AS GCS ON (GC.GuestCheckInCode = GCS.GuestCheckInCode),
	Guest G
WHERE
	GC.GuestCheckInCode = :ai_code AND
	GC.GuestCode = G.GuestCode
